description: Does guidance raise how often the policy grips the blue block? The grip-only task (calvin_exp_configs_examples/tasks/blue_grip_table_right.json) with the base policy and guided at scale 1.5, 3 and 5, all from the same start scenes (seed 0). Unguided, the base policy gripped in 2 of 10 rollouts of 150 steps on the MacBook. Success = the env counts the block as held. Run on the workstation with dynaguide_scripts/run_grip_scale_sweep.bat
